correctness.rationale: Uniform block normal form for all automorphisms follows from the free two-step bracket, with square-one criterion \(G^2=I\) and \(fG+(\bigwedge^2G)f=0\). In odd characteristic the ± eigenblock dimensions give \(K_{a,b}\), the Gaussian conjugacy factor and conjugation by a central shear, leading to \(d+1\) classes and the sharp \(\lfloor d^2/4\rfloor\) fixed-space lower bound. In characteristic two the J2/J1 tensor-exterior-square decomposition and Hom_{k[C2]} dimensions give \(E_{d,r}\); counting rank-r square-zero matrices yields the exact census. Standalone checker enumerated 2x2 odd/even examples and 3x3 binary cases fully and verified all induced matrices up to 4x4 binary. No claim of finite-code proof of infinite cases.

value.rationale: Counting the entire natural square-one locus of a free nilpotent Lie automorphism group over every finite field, rather than an arbitrary parameter slice, exposes a real characteristic-two modular decomposition versus odd semisimplicity. The odd-dimensional conjugacy/fixed-point classification and sharp bound supply interpretable structural invariants for infinitely many Lie algebras; the even-characteristic formula requires nontrivial modular tensor-Hom multiplicities.
